accepted.title: POSTAL 2 — PC Gamer review
accepted.identity_evidence: Critic review for POSTAL 2 attributed by Metacritic to PC Gamer.
evidence_points: A nonstop tour de force of insulting insanity. And even though I should be disgusted by the potty humor and derogatory caricatures, I had a blast playing through it. [June 2003, p.74]

accepted.title: POSTAL 2 — Game Informer review
accepted.identity_evidence: Critic review for POSTAL 2 attributed by Metacritic to Game Informer.
evidence_points: There's a refreshing non-linearity to Postal 2. [June 2003, p.116]
